d:
City Beautiful, renamed: Chandigarh, Dilpreet Dhillon style! Presenting Chandigarh, sung by Dilpreet Dhillon, with lyrics by Narinder Batth and music by Desi Crew, from the EP Another Level.
Swag, attitude and pure Chandigarh vibes, a full anthem for the City Beautiful and everyone who calls it home
EP - Another Level
Song - Chandigarh
Singer - Dilpreet Dhillon
Lyrics - Narinder Batth
Music - Desi Crew
Label - Speed Records
